text:
mike (sales): Prospective customer (RegBank) asked for IAM evidence in the SIG. They want: admin role separation, MFA enforcement for admin console, SCIM provisioning logs, service-account rotation policy, and confirmation that Dedicated isolates tenant visibility. Can we assemble a minimal package by EOD?

olga (eng-security): We have a lean set we can share quickly: 1) SAML->role mapping snippet (Okta), 2) MFA policy screenshot for admin group, 3) SCIM export CSV (redacted), 4) Vault rotation policy + a 90d rotation log sample, 5) tenant-scoped policy YAML for Dedicated.

olga (eng-security): SAML role claim example:
<saml:Attribute Name="roles">
  <saml:AttributeValue>redwood_admin</saml:AttributeValue>
</saml:Attribute>

olga (eng-security): SCIM sample row: `2025-02-10T09:12:11Z,j.smith@regbank.com,activated,okta,groups:RBAC-ADMINS`

devon (solutions): For rotation logs we can run: `curl -s "https://logs.internal/api/search?q=event:rotation&from=-90d" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"` then sanitize. Use `tools/redact_logs.py --mask-emails`.

olga (eng-security): Dedicated isolation note: control plane enforces `scope: project:<tenant>` on all bindings; API gateway filters by tenant_id. We'll attach a short diagram and sample binding: `bind role:project-admin -> group:regbank-admins (scope:project:regbank-prod)`.

devon (solutions): Break-glass: short-lived elevated tokens issued via ticket approval; approvals recorded in Jira. We'll attach a redacted approval transcript.

ops-bot: artifact-upload: iam-evidence-minipack.zip uploaded to /internal/uploads/1959001234-iam.zip :white_check_mark:

mike (sales): Excellent. I'll send to their vendor team and follow up if they push to CAIQ. Thanks all :pray:
